violation_type.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Water Safety training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(8)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Water Safety training
violation_type.typical_finding: Employees were lacking of water safety trainings during the inspection time.

finding_variants.text: Employees were lacking of water safety trainings during the inspection time.
Employees water safety trainings were not available during the inspection time.

A director did not have a training certificate available for review in water safety.   Noted: This was corrected during inspection when the current training certificate was used for the previous training year.
A staff had water safety training that was expired as it was to be completed by 5/28/2026.
